tools.name: list_hazards
tools.description: List the hazard checklist used for a Gefährdungsbeurteilung, grouped by the six categories of ArbSchG §5(3). Read this first, then pick IDs for assess_workplace.

tools.name: assess_workplace
tools.description: Assess a workplace against the section 5(3) hazard checklist. Returns risk level per hazard, the gaps that are not low, and the next review date. Deterministic: same input gives the same output.

tools.name: documentation
tools.description: Build the section 6 ArbSchG documentation record for an assessment: result, measures and the review result field. Returns the three fields section 6 requires.

tools.name: review_due
tools.description: Return the next review date for a risk level (high 180 days, medium 365, low 730).
